SmbusPIIX4.bin: PawnIO.Modules 0.2.11 (https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules), LGPL-2.1, unmodified.
SHA-256 of the release zip: 43608cb89bc84247fef1368a139013f7d043e17db6d6c8dfc9b46bf0905a81f4

The installer also carries PawnIO_setup.exe 2.2.0 (https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup, the
PawnIO driver, GPL-2.0: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO), unmodified and signed by its author,
downloaded and checked by installer\build.ps1. It is only run when the driver is missing.
